classifications.name: UTF16LE keeps NUL and odd trailing byte

expected.refusal: File is UTF-16 big-endian (it starts FE FF), which these tools cannot write. These tools write UTF-8 (or UTF-16LE behind its byte-order mark) and never convert a file's encoding on their own, so nothing was written. If the file is text, make the change with a shell command that reads and writes it in its own encoding (iconv, or PowerShell Get-Content/Set-Content -Encoding), or ask the user whether to convert it to UTF-8 first. To replace the whole file with new UTF-8 text anyway, delete it first, then Write it.
